text:
Minsiri Clinic accepts both the Gold Card and Social Security. Those living in the Minburi area on Ramkhamhaeng Road can easily access it. It's just past the Susco gas station and 150 meters down the alley.
The clinic is spacious and not crowded. There are only 3-4 examination rooms. However, I deducted 1 point because of the long wait times. I've been here at least 10 times, and each time I've waited over an hour. There were less than 5 patients. My first visit also took a long time, so I wasn't impressed.
The staff provided excellent service and provided excellent advice. I give them full marks for this.
The treatment is excellent and I highly recommend it.
